asr.full_text: intro And before I start this video, i want to say thank you first to all of you, because, we already have 100 thousand subscribers And, I don't care if you want to be called a manjat or anything else the point is that I still make content about the development of technology right now and I still provide information that hopefully will be useful for all of you Of course with content that always discusses the evolution of technology, what is it like? Ok, for the discussion With the content that ever says technologies development. For this review was a motherboard and the lowest entry level chipset, Intel Kavilec H310 The H310 will be explained from Ashrock H310M-HDV, I wanted to make a computer using this motherboard, because I made the first version for the AMD version, but due to the time given by Ashrock is enough for a short time. so, what's wrong if we just discuss this motherboard and we see if we make a computer using the entry-level this motherboard, and we will see how if we build a PC using this Entry-level motherboard we will get anything and something that we can optimize from this cheap motherboard for Intel Cavillac, with the hope that you will understand or understand if you will have a device using Intel. Okay the short form of this motherboard is actually very simple, this could also be a series of followings from H110M HDVI, which used to be a bit common in the market. Because of course the price is cheap and the name Asrock is quite reliable to its users. The price of the motherboard when I made this video was Rp 1.059.000 for the M.2 version, and Rp 1.019.000 for the ordinary one, aka there is no M.2 version. The only difference is in the M.2 slot, the Unit on there aren't m.2. The difference is only on the M.2 slot the unit that I had this is a version with m.2, m.2 slot, motherboard already supports PCI Express for the m.2 slot, alias you can already use mvme SSD, but the PCI Express is still second generation so the bandwidth is only 20 Gb per second most mvme that is currently running has used PCI Express it will result in an SSD which has limitations for its speed except if you use ssd m.1 or nvme ssd which using PCI Express the second generation but I assume it's focus Astrog It doesn't really focus their users on using nvmi SSDs on this motherboard m.2 slot here I think so that low-end users can use Intel obtained memory because if we look at the previous series the motherboard like the c cipset H110i does n't support Intel opt-in to use Intel Optane, we need a motherboard or chipset with B250 and a CPU that supports that with kabylaks architecture. So indeed, we have no option for cheap motherboards if we want to use Intel Optane memory. But now, Intel Pentium Gold users can probably feel the called Intel Optem Memories module for accelerating their hard disk. Because this is a 300 series chipset, that shows that the LGA 1151 socket here can only be used for Intel Gen 8 or Kvalic, so you can't use Skylake or Kavilac. It should be known that this H3 H310 class will usually be given a very very simple VRM. The VRM motherboard is 4 plus 1 power paste. Although Aceroq claims that this motherboard is capable of running CPUs with TDP 95 watts, I do not recommend you to use CPUs like Core i5 8600K or 8700K, because these VRM is very suitable for this I5 8400 for testing here I use the I3 8100 using the i3 8100 is not yet making VRM hurt because if we look at the temperature it is still on the 50 degrees Celsius The memory slot available here there are only two demp DDR4 with a maximum speed of 2 dvm 665 MHz h310 can't go for full-stage memory overclocking and memory speed limitations will also be influenced by the CPU you are using if you use Pentium Gold or you Core i3 then the maximum speed memory will only be 2400 mhz when you connect from Core i5 to above it can only use up 2666 mhz of maximum speed memory it's unfortunate that after I checked BIOS from this motherboard turns out that the h310m-MHDVI doesn't have XMP features. So we have to set the manual if we want to run RAM in 2400 or in 2666MHz. Fortunately, here we can optimize the memory performance by changing the timer tighter. For those who are experts in RAM memory, here ASRock also sets the timing to set the operating speed. At least we still can do some work so we can get fast speeds. And for the IOPort, of course we just find the standard one. We didn't need to protest because it's cheap! But for SATA slots, we got 4 slots with more than enough position and there is jumper here if you want to reset BIOS or clear this is not an expensive motherboard for Zata slot we get 4 slots with positions that don't interfere and next to it there is a jumper if you want to reset bios or clear siemens as a result of error or failure because of settings, settings. The BIOS is basically total Slotvan there are 32 at top and one at bottom of the layout, which in my opinion does not involve cable management and more so Well, this motherboard has a simple design hoping for something very special is difficult what we need to do, is to lower our expectations and to find out how to optimize it Unfortunately, Intel low-end chipset is quite limited therefore, there are a few ways to optimize the cheap platform for Intel. But considering that Intel mid-range users are more comfortable with running a system out of the box, I don't think Intel's doing that wrong, because not everyone likes to operate their PC either. But that's what I think, if what do you think, comment below. Okay, don't forget to like, share and subscribe if this video is interesting to you follow my social media, if you are bored with what's behind the front of GAPTEK Also buy GAPTEK merchandise, all links are in the description I'm Sup Kie, see you next time
